description: New General ACCDB. MI(ID Long primary key, MK MEMO, TK TEXT(255)) with 8 rows from the memo set. Then each of 10 statements on its own, with an image kept after each: CREATE INDEX and CREATE UNIQUE INDEX on MK, MK DESC, (TK, MK) and (MK, TK); ADD CONSTRAINT UNIQUE (MK); tables whose MEMO column is a primary key or has a unique constraint (column and table form); and CREATE INDEX on TK as the control. Then DAO TableDef.CreateIndex with a field MK appended to a non-unique, to a unique and to a primary index. Reads every index of MI, MI3, MI4 and MI5. Asks whether a memo column can be a native key in any route, and which refusal each route gives.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
